meta.description: CV and resume for Daniel Peters, Interaction Designer & Product Designer.

header.name: Daniel Peters
header.coreRoles: Core roles: Interaction Design · UX/UI Design · Cross-functional Collaboration
header.summary: Interaction Designer with 5+ years of experience designing enterprise software for complex domains. Specializes in translating dense system architectures into intuitive interfaces, working closely with engineering and product management in cross-functional agile teams.

experience.title: Interaction Designer (Management Consultant)
experience.coreRoles: Core roles: Interaction Design · UX/UI Product Design · Agile Delivery
experience.summary: Led interaction design for complex internal tools in a cross-functional setup. Bridged the gap between business requirements, user needs, and technical implementation.
bullets: Workflow Automation (SAP RPA): Designed intuitive UI workflows that replaced manual, error-prone data handling. By reducing cognitive load, the solution saved a 40-person expert team an estimated 2–4 hours per week.
End-to-End Interaction Design: Developed user flows, storyboards, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes for compliance and diagnostic tools (e.g., Audi KoVoN), simplifying deep task hierarchies.
Engineering Collaboration: Worked directly with developers to establish clear UI specifications and edge-case documentation, reducing UI bugs in review and improving sprint predictability.
Process Iteration: Conducted usability testing and iterative design reviews with stakeholders to ensure features met both user expectations and strict technical constraints.

experience.title: Freelance UX/UI Designer
bullets: Partnered with founders and SMEs to design and build user-centric digital products from initial concept to launch.
Created comprehensive user journeys, wireframes, and interactive prototypes in Figma, translating core brand requirements into responsive web experiences.
Managed client communication, technical constraints (CMS/Webflow), and rapid design iterations under lean project budgets.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Design Lead
bullets: Led a small creative team to build a cohesive visual identity and digital experience, helping scale the cultural event to over 3,000 attendees.
Oversaw the end-to-end design execution across web and physical touchpoints, managing real-time logistics and vendor collaboration.
